The eye is visible, dark, and surrounded by dense fur, matching the description.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear location is covered by the thick mane/fur, which is typical for bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is extremely prominent and rises significantly higher than the rest of the visible backline, indicating the massive build described.
